title: [Audit] System index requests (raw)
description: The newest 1,000 requests against .kibana*, .security*, .alerts-* and other system indices, one row per index named: privileged data access worth a second look. Ordinary data-stream backing indices are left out.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, elasticsearch.audit.action, elasticsearch.audit.indices, client.ip | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, elasticsearch.audit.action AS `Transport action`, client.ip AS `Client IP`, elasticsearch.audit.indices AS Index
